text: 你的四名同伴设法抓住了受损的独木舟。水流把他们冲到一处堆满漂木的沙洲上。查理带着学生们脱险；你则奋力对抗急流。裹挟着杂物的水流把你冲得东倒西歪。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 12
text: Your four companions manage to hold onto the battered canoe. The current carries them to a drift-strewn sandbar. Charlie gets the students to safety as you fight the rushing water. Thick with debris, it tosses you around.
